gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-slabo-13px: Balsamiq Sans draws its heading in a stencil-cut channel of constant width, bold and loose. Slabo 13px follows as a serif with big open counters, bookish and dignified beneath the display shouting.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum is a dignified text serif whose high, squared-off x-height gives every line a woodblock heft and presence. Balsamiq Sans brings the bold, expressive shout; the body does the patient talking.
gen-gf-barriecito-fs-karma: Open bowls, tipped like a ladle, give Barriecito its whole personality. Karma sits beneath as a classic serif, trustworthy, with little gap between x-height and caps and a modulation too gentle to snag the eye.
gen-gf-barriecito-fs-paquito: Paquito reads confident and approachable, with lowercase that rises almost to the capitals' height. Over a longer stretch it would feel friendly but a bit tight, while Barriecito, with its ladle-like bowls, supplies the flourish up top.
gen-gf-battambang-fs-karma: Distinctive and expressive, Battambang runs compressed. Karma's modest gap between stems and hairlines gives the serif body a trustworthy, classic steadiness, and its open terminals are the pair's best single quality.
gen-gf-battambang-fs-paquito: Paquito is a confident, approachable serif whose lowercase barely drops below the capitals, set under Battambang's compressed ascenders. Past a few lines it would feel chunky and friendly.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-epunda-slab: Commanding, Baumans opens its c like a wrench and draws every stroke at one thickness. Epunda Slab, a classic serif with tall rounded lowercase and a gaping c, is the dignified counterweight to it.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-fauna-one: Wrench-wide c's, monoweight strokes: Baumans looks like machined metal, and it commands attention. But Fauna One, a literary serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, softens the whole effect with real dignity.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-glegoo: Glegoo reads refined and editorial as a text serif, its big counters and wide-mouthed curves giving the lowercase generous room. And Baumans, with round letters bent like wire, feels more mechanical and commanding beside it.
gen-gf-baumans-gf-hanuman: Hanuman carries a traditional, refined voice, with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s. And over a longer passage it would feel settled and bookish, while Baumans, bent like tubing, handles the commanding part.
